items.headline: Philippines taps India's GMR Group for $11 billion Manila airport project
items.summary: The Philippines has tapped India's GMR Group to develop an $11 billion airport, The Business Times reported. The award is part of a shift by Manila toward courting private capital from Asian investors rather than relying on official development aid.
items.why_it_matters: The scale of the award signals rising Indian infrastructure appetite for Southeast Asian aviation assets and underscores the region's reliance on private capital to fund large infrastructure build-outs.

items.headline: MAS financial stability review flags AI-pullback and global-shock risks, says Singapore well-buffered
items.summary: The Monetary Authority of Singapore's latest Financial Stability Review warned of risks from fresh global shocks and a potential pullback in AI-related investment, CNA reported. It said Singapore firms and households remain well-buffered, though economies that have benefited from AI-related exports and investment are among the most exposed if the AI boom cools.
items.why_it_matters: The warning points to a build-up of debt tied to AI-driven capital spending across the region, a risk credit investors will want to track as financing for data-centre and chip investment keeps growing.

items.headline: PhonePe secures initial UAE central bank approval for payment licence
items.summary: India's PhonePe has received initial approval from the UAE central bank for payment licences, CNA reported. The nod is a preliminary step and does not amount to a full licence.
items.why_it_matters: The approval would extend PhonePe's digital-payments footprint into the Gulf, a market increasingly targeted by South and Southeast Asian fintechs seeking growth outside home markets.

items.headline: Binance faces US scrutiny over possible Iran sanctions violations, Bloomberg reports
items.summary: Binance is under scrutiny from US authorities over possible violations of Iran sanctions, Bloomberg News reported, according to CNA. Details of the alleged violations were not disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: Renewed US sanctions scrutiny adds to compliance risk facing crypto exchanges, a factor institutional counterparties and lenders with Binance exposure will want to monitor.
